chunks.head: wear off
chunks.note: wear off 指感觉、疼痛、效果等慢慢减弱直至消失。
chunks.ex_en: After an hour the pain began to wear off.
chunks.ex_cn: 一小时后疼痛开始渐渐消退。

chunks.head: make one's escape
chunks.note: make one's escape = 成功逃离(常从危险或囚禁中)。
chunks.ex_en: The thief made his escape through the back window.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷从后窗逃走了。

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.gloss: 遇到、碰到(困难、情况、事物)
chunks.note: meet with 常接抽象事物：meet with success/difficulty/an accident。
chunks.ex_en: Her plan met with a lot of support.
chunks.ex_cn: 她的计划得到了很多支持。

chunks.head: become of
chunks.gloss: (某人/某物)的结果如何、下场如何
chunks.note: 多用于疑问：what will become of …? = …会怎么样、落得什么下场。
chunks.ex_en: What will become of the dog if they move away?
chunks.ex_cn: 他们搬走后那只狗会怎么样呢？

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of 修饰不可数名词，等于 much。
chunks.ex_en: He spent a great deal of time on this drawing.
chunks.ex_cn: 他在这幅画上花了大量时间。

chunks.head: put off
chunks.note: put off = 把某事推到以后再做，可接名词或 doing。
chunks.ex_en: We had to put off the picnic because of the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 因为下雨我们只好把野餐推迟了。

chunks.head: lay up
chunks.note: lay up 指把粮食、物资等积攒储存起来备用。
chunks.ex_en: The farmer laid up enough grain for the winter.
chunks.ex_cn: 农夫储备了足够过冬的粮食。

chunks.head: take turns
chunks.note: take turns (doing sth / to do sth) = 大家轮换着做。
chunks.ex_en: The two boys take turns riding the bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 两个男孩轮流骑那辆自行车。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上(相对于在船上或海里)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were happy to be on shore again.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们很高兴又回到了岸上。

chunks.head: leave behind
chunks.note: leave behind = 把人或物留在原地不带走。
chunks.ex_en: Don't leave your bag behind on the train.
chunks.ex_cn: 别把你的包落在火车上。

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.note: stand by sb = 在困难时支持某人、不离不弃。
chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand by you in hard times.
chunks.ex_cn: 真正的朋友会在困难时支持你。

chunks.head: occur to
chunks.gloss: (想法)突然出现在某人脑中、想到
chunks.note: sth occurs to sb = 某人忽然想到某事(主语是那个念头)。
chunks.ex_en: It suddenly occurred to me that I had left the door open.
chunks.ex_cn: 我突然想到我没关门。

chunks.head: fall into the hands of
chunks.note: fall into the hands of sb = 被某人(常指坏人)控制或抓住。
chunks.ex_en: The letters must not fall into the hands of our enemies.
chunks.ex_cn: 这些信绝不能落入我们敌人之手。

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime 指在两件事之间的这段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner will be ready soon; in the meantime, sit down and relax.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭很快就好；这期间你先坐下歇会儿。

chunks.head: in vain
chunks.note: in vain = 没有结果、白做了。
chunks.ex_en: We searched all day, but in vain.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们找了一整天，却是徒劳。

chunks.head: spare someone's life
chunks.note: spare sb's life = 免于处死、放过某人。
chunks.ex_en: The king decided to spare the prisoner's life.
chunks.ex_cn: 国王决定饶那囚犯一命。

chunks.head: guilty of
chunks.note: be guilty of sth = 做了某种错事或罪行。
chunks.ex_en: He was found guilty of stealing the money.
chunks.ex_cn: 他被判犯有偷钱罪。

chunks.head: at a loss
chunks.note: at a loss (what to do / for words) = 一时想不出办法或话来。
chunks.ex_en: She was at a loss and didn't know what to say.
chunks.ex_cn: 她不知所措，不知道该说什么。

chunks.head: above all
chunks.note: above all 用来强调最重要的一点。
chunks.ex_en: Above all, remember to stay calm.
chunks.ex_cn: 最重要的是，记得保持冷静。

chunks.head: at the mercy of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(at the mercy and discretion of)，故 card-only。at the mercy of = 完全由某人/某物左右、无力反抗。
chunks.ex_en: The small boat was at the mercy of the waves.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只小船任由海浪摆布。

chunks.head: take into consideration
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(take my former thoughts … into consideration)，故 card-only。take sth into consideration = 在做决定时把某因素考虑进去。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher takes each student's effort into consideration.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师会把每个学生的努力考虑在内。
